regulatory_and_risk_profile: Brand safety and public hallucination liability
Consumer privacy obligations (CCPA, GDPR) for customer data
Extreme peak seasonality (BFCM and holiday traffic spikes)
paper_process_blockers: PCI-DSS scope review before any payment-adjacent flow goes live
Privacy review of customer data flows
Annual budget cycle that locks seasonal support capacity
dominant_friction: A brand failure can go viral in an afternoon, and seasonal spikes make variable costs swing sharply.
value_frame: Anchor on conversion lift, brand-safe guardrails, elastic outcome-based pricing during seasonal spikes, and a 14-day time to value.

buying_committee.primary_fear: An AI agent hallucinates unauthorized discounts or off-brand messaging in public.
The launch misses the holiday window.
We pay for shelfware seats or unmeasured pilot sprawl.
Runaway variable usage bills during Q4 holiday surges.

signature_objections: Our seasonal volume jumps 6x in November. How do we cap runaway token or action spend?
If your agent promises a customer a refund outside policy, who eats the brand and financial hit?
We already have 12 legacy POS and loyalty systems. Why won't this take 18 months to integrate?

metrics.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
metrics.setup: The board wants to see assisted conversion move before the holiday peak.
metrics.partial: We watch conversion every week, but the agent's impact is not separated out yet, and cost per resolution matters just as much.
metrics.verbatim: Cost per resolution down by a third before the holiday peak, and assisted conversion up at least 1.5 points.

economic_buyer.speaker: CMO
economic_buyer.setup: If this works, I can find the money in the digital budget.
economic_buyer.partial: I sign for digital up to a cap. Seasonal spend is where finance gets involved.
economic_buyer.verbatim: Up to the cap, I sign the pilot myself. Any seasonal commitment above it needs the CFO's approval.

decision_criteria.speaker: CMO
decision_criteria.setup: We are comparing a few vendors, and brand safety is my first question for all of them.
decision_criteria.partial: Brand safety outweighs everything else. The tie-breaker is how an agent handles discounts.
decision_criteria.verbatim: An agent that offers discounts outside a published policy with hard limits, or fails our brand-safety test suite. Either one rules you out.

decision_process.speaker: CMO
decision_process.setup: Anything we launch for the holidays has to be live before November.
decision_process.partial: Brand review comes first, then seasonal spend goes through the budget cycle. It is tight before November.
decision_process.verbatim: Brand review, then privacy review, then the CFO signs off on seasonal spend. The budget has to be locked by the end of September.

paper_process.speaker: CFO
paper_process.setup: Anything near checkout gets extra scrutiny from security, including a PCI scope review.
paper_process.partial: They can start, but PCI scope reviews on anything that touches the payment flow are never quick.
paper_process.verbatim: About six weeks, and nothing touches the payment flow until it is done.

identify_pain.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
identify_pain.setup: Last holiday, the contact center surge was painful.
identify_pain.partial: More than it should. Volume overwhelms the contact center every year, and we pay for it.
identify_pain.verbatim: The same as last year: an emergency BPO surge at double rate, and we still missed our CSAT target by eight points.

champion.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
champion.setup: Anything like this gets argued out in our Monday growth review.
champion.partial: I would lead with conversion and back it myself. The CFO will be the harder audience.
champion.verbatim: A pilot scoped to the holiday peak with clear exit gates. With that, I will champion it in the growth review myself.

competition.speaker: CFO
competition.setup: I should say we are not short of options here.
competition.partial: We would not build it. Our commerce platform already bundles an assistant we pay for.
competition.verbatim: That bundled assistant comes with our renewal, so you have to prove incremental lift over what we already have.

veto_holder.reason: One off-brand answer in public ends the program, so brand safety outranks price.

metrics.open: What number has to move on assisted conversion for this to be worth it, and by when?
metrics.pin: How much do you need to cut cost per resolution before the holiday peak?

economic_buyer.open: Who signs the PO for the digital budget, and up to what amount?
economic_buyer.pin: For seasonal spend above the cap, whose budget does this come out of, and who has the final sign-off?

decision_criteria.open: How will you score vendors on brand safety? Which criterion breaks a tie?
decision_criteria.pin: What would rule us out with your brand team, regardless of price?

decision_process.open: After a successful pilot, what happens on day one, day ten and day thirty before November?
decision_process.pin: Who else needs to approve seasonal spend? Walk me through the approval path.

paper_process.open: Can security start the PCI scope review in parallel with the pilot?
paper_process.pin: How long does the PCI scope review take before anything touches the payment flow?

identify_pain.open: What does last holiday's contact center surge cost you each year?
identify_pain.pin: What happens if you do nothing and holiday volume spikes again?

champion.open: If I am not in the room, how would you make the case in the Monday growth review?
champion.pin: What would you need to take this to the CFO and the growth review with confidence?

competition.open: What happens if you build this in-house, or do nothing?
competition.pin: What are you comparing us against, including the assistant bundled with your commerce platform?

account_research.buyer_line: What do you already know about how we run digital here?
account_research.strong: I saw you moved the contact center under digital before last holiday. What prompted that?

discovery_questioning.strong: Walk me through how a customer question gets handled today, start to finish.

listening_summarizing.buyer_line: One thing before we go on. The bigger issue for us is the holiday surge, not the everyday volume.
listening_summarizing.strong: So the real cost is the holiday surge, not the everyday volume. Did I get that right?

commercial_insight.strong: Brands like yours lose more to abandoned carts during peak than to support costs. Here is the number.

value_messaging.strong: Today, eight-minute waits at peak. After, instant answers, proven with a brand your size.

answer_first.strong: My recommendation: start with order-status questions before the holiday peak. Three reasons.
